motion: backward continuous differences only; explicit known flag; zero placeholder for unknown
visibility: current co-visible sender/receiver; unknown velocity allowed as position-only message with explicit flag
S: pair first co-visible distance<=radius; nearest/stableID among new pairs fills permanent K slots; edges thereafter visibility-masked only; rejected pairs never reconsidered
D: current co-visible within radius, lowest current distance topK, stable source-ID ties
R: exact D candidate pool and K, highest risk topK then stable sourceID; missing velocity distance-only risk fallback
shared_message_features: relative position2, relative velocity2, receiver/source velocity-known2, distance1,DCA1,tCPA1

model.encoder: GRUCell(3,64), per-agent causal reset on missing/reentry
model.messages: single-hop MLP(73,64,64), ReLU; mean over incoming edges, then mean over message-bearing continuous history frames
model.decoder: MLP(128,64,24), ReLU; 12 cumulative displacements anchored at last historical position
model.future_loss_reference: masked mean Euclidean regression, not executed

no_neighbor: social vector exactly zero; identical weights E vs social returns identical prediction
capacity: same nominal parameters all four; E message and decoder social columns inactive; E not sufficient sole capacity control

synthetic_smoke.objective: synthetic output square mean for backward only

estimated_future_budget.steps: ceil(supervised_scene_windows/8)*30; all target labels each epoch
estimated_future_budget.hypothetical_optimizer: Adam lr.001 clip1, no scheduler; requires separate Stage10B freeze
estimated_future_budget.checkpoint_rule: lowest validation target-window ADE, earliest exact ties; paired FDE
estimated_future_budget.decision: no Stage10B automatic launch; novelty overlap must be resolved or scoped as replication

refusal_conditions: unbounded memory or OOM; no deleting crowded scenes to pass

reuse.code: Original Stage10 implementation; only read-only HTraj Recording/history_context and SHA utilities interfaces reused
reuse.license_note: Local parsers authored within HTraj; no third-party model code copied; vendor licenses remain unchanged
